_comment: Hooks for flask-plugin. PostToolUse: format the changed Python file with ruff. Tries Docker first (service 'app'), falls back to the local ruff CLI, swallows errors so it never blocks the user.

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_FILE"; case "$f" in *.py) docker compose exec -T app ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null || ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null; exit 0;; esac
